floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 8 confirmed; 8 diffs are TWO independent reg-alloc/scheduling ties (inner sum/j $a0 swap; 2nd-loop LICM-const vs move preheader order) — both pure-C, greg-characterized, frontier built.
Region A quantified as a pure sum/j $a0<->$a1 swap (all surroundings match target); naive structural levers KILLED, pointing to the directed permuter.

Region A range-mechanism CONFIRMED: offset+=j flips the sum/j a0/a1 swap (score 7) but is not match-viable; zero-cost manual flips killed, so the flip needs the directed permuter's whole-function LUID

frontier.hypothesis: The directed permuter, seeded from the floor-8 form, sweeps the whole-function LUID cross-product that manual source order cannot reach, flipping Region A (sum/j) with the literal offset intact and/or the Region B const-vs-move order.
frontier.mechanism: s3 proved Region A flips purely on j-vs-sum global-allocno priority and that the target register order (sum=a0/j=a1) IS reachable (offset+=j reaches it). The permuter must reach the same allocation without an emitted j-consumer, by perturbing whole-function statement order / LUID context. PERM_* over statement order in both regions + the range-check spelling. Vet any closing form against the cheat catalog (offset+=j-style range steering, constant-holder, dead-store are the known traps).
frontier.next_probe: Build clean single-fn target.o (asm/funcs/damage_DebugDisp.s + prelude, drop .set gp=64), seed base from candidate.c, run permuter_campaign with fresh-seed stopping rule; log to tmp/grind/damage_DebugDisp/sN/. Watch for the qty_order 78 77 79 signal at score<=8 with the literal `addiu $a3,$a3,0x24` preserved.

frontier.hypothesis: Region B: a surrounding-code change makes the LICM range-check constants schedule (lower LUID) before the ap/a2p pre-loop moves without a constant-holder.
frontier.mechanism: Constants are hoisted to preheader END (higher LUID) so sched1 picks the lower-LUID moves first. Only the permuter's cross-product (or a genuine control-flow change to where the range check materializes) can reorder them; every manual source lever measured is either no-change or the rejected magic_base cheat.
frontier.next_probe: In the same permuter campaign, include PERM_* over the k-loop preheader / range-check form; keep only variants that hold score<=8 and emit lui $t0/lui $a3/ori $a3 before move $a0/move $a2.
